description: Keep Monica, your personal CRM, up to date without opening it: add people and their details, write notes, log activities and calls, set reminders and tasks, tag contacts and note gifts and debts. Start a workflow when a contact, note, activity, task or journal entry is added, or when a reminder or birthday comes due.
